stem.text: Gas Q decomposes slowly at room temperature.
The Boltzmann distribution curve for gas Q at room temperature is shown.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution curve of number of particles against energy: the curve rises from the origin to a peak at low energy and falls away, with a vertical dotted line at E_a and a tail levelling off at high energy.

stem.text: Which change occurs when a catalyst is added to gas Q?

A.text: The peak of the curve moves to the right on the diagram.

B.text: The number of particles with enough energy to decompose increases.

C.text: The kinetic energy of the unreacted particles increases.

D.text: The value of $E_\text{a}$ decreases, moving the vertical dotted line to the right on the diagram.
